module: Tiny demo extension for a "booster" trigger: trigger(data) prints the received data, then should propel a vehicle upward via core_booster on the vehicle side. In the current state of the code, the propulsion never fires.
notes: Bug: trigger tests the global variable `event` (nil) instead of `data.event`, so the condition `event == 'enter'` is always false and the vehicle is never propelled; only print and dump are executed.
If the condition were true, it would send the vehicle data.subjectID the command extensions.core_booster.boost(vec3(0,0,1), 0.01).

trigger.desc: Prints "Booster triggered" and the contents of data. Intended to react to a trigger event (data.subjectID is the vehicle id), but does nothing else because of the reported bug.
